title: Joomla! Core - [20261145] - Core - Improper ACL checks in com_media file creation in Joomla 4.0.0-5.4.10, 6.0.0-6.2.0…
description: Joomla! Core - [20261145] - Core - Improper ACL checks in com_media file creation in Joomla 4.0.0-5.4.10, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - Inadequate ACL checks in the media manager allowed users without create permission to create new files by using the override option.
